about: What this member said on the floor, from the Congressional Record: their own words only, and of those the sentences that name an alignment question's phrases or make a commitment. Written by npm run record:collect (scripts/collect-record.mjs).
name: William R. Timmons IV

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SUPERVISORY MODIFICATIONS FOR APPROPRIATE RISK-BASED TESTING ACT OF 2025
statements.title: SUPERVISORY MODIFICATIONS FOR APPROPRIATE RISK-BASED TESTING ACT OF 2025
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise in support of my bill, H.R. 4437, the Supervisory Modifications for Appropriate Risk-based Testing Act, also known as the SMART Act.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues on both sides of the aisle to support this bipartisan legislation that promotes efficiency and smarter regulation.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: INFORMATION QUALITY ASSURANCE ACT OF 2025
statements.title: INFORMATION QUALITY ASSURANCE ACT OF 2025
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise in support of H.R. 6329, the Information Quality Assurance Act of 2025.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to support this bill and thank Representative Lisa McClain for her reintroduction of this important legislation.
Mr. Speaker, I strongly support this bill.
I urge my colleagues on both sides of the aisle to join me in support of this important legislation.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SKILLS-BASED FEDERAL CONTRACTING ACT OF 2025
statements.title: SKILLS-BASED FEDERAL CONTRACTING ACT OF 2025
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise in support of H.R. 5235, the Skills-Based Federal Contracting Act, which reins in unnecessary degree requirements in Federal contracting.
Mr. Speaker, I strongly support this bill.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: STRENGTHENING AGENCY MANAGEMENT AND OVERSIGHT OF SOFTWARE ASSETS ACT
statements.title: STRENGTHENING AGENCY MANAGEMENT AND OVERSIGHT OF SOFTWARE ASSETS ACT
sentences: The result is wasteful spending on duplicative or unnecessary software licenses.
This will reduce wasteful spending and improve government efficiency.
Mr. Speaker, I encourage my colleagues to support this commonsense legislation that will reduce wasteful spending and improve government efficiency.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: IMPROVING CAPITAL ALLOCATION FOR NEWCOMERS ACT OF 2025
statements.title: IMPROVING CAPITAL ALLOCATION FOR NEWCOMERS ACT OF 2025
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues on both sides of the aisle to support this legislation and to help ensure that investors and entrepreneurs in every one of our districts have a fair and level playing field.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DISTRICT OF COLUMBIA FEDERAL IMMIGRATION COMPLIANCE ACT OF 2025
statements.title: DISTRICT OF COLUMBIA FEDERAL IMMIGRATION COMPLIANCE ACT OF 2025
sentences: Justice Sotomayor's detail shot an 18-year-old multiple times because he was trying to rob the Supreme Court Justice.
We are talking about something very simple: Abide by Federal detainers.
If the Federal Government says you have arrested an illegal immigrant who has a criminal detainer, you have to follow the law.
Get them mental health counseling.
Mr. Speaker, I rise today in strong support of H.R. 2056, the District of Columbia Federal Immigration Compliance Act.
We are going to use every tool in our toolbox to make this District what it should be.
We are going to make this city safe.
We are going to show the world that we are not a nation in decline.
We are going to not only Make America Great Again, but we are going to make the United States Capital great again.
